page.overview:
What is Magnolia Road?

Magnolia Road was a street located in Little Whinging. It was on the opposite side of Magnolia Crescent from Privet Drive. There was a playground on this street, where Dudley Dursley and his gang had broken all but one of the swings, and where Harry Potter sat thinking about his godfather Sirius Black and Cedric Diggory in the summer of 1995.
